description: Every GPU rental index and AI company token index the site lists: whether it is listed (has a price, a month of history and a value for each of its 1-day, 1-week and 1-month changes), its latest value and day, when its history starts, its provider or model count, its benchmark contract (GPUs) and its page, and the GPUs on the Every GPU page. Use it to see what the other tools accept.

errata.description: Errors found in its latest value, as its page notes them. As the page notes them under its value and the status page lists them: each a run of index days. A final value is never changed; the correct one is given when it can be recomputed, and the error is fixed from the next day
